description_for_human: Explore the UI/UX design portfolio of Prathamesh Patil — case studies, projects, and contact information.
description_for_model: This plugin provides access to Prathamesh Patil's UI/UX design portfolio. Use it to retrieve project information, case studies (like PathParcel), contact details, and professional background. Prathamesh is a UI/UX Designer and Frontend Developer based in Kalyan, Maharashtra, India, specializing in storytelling design portfolios, design systems, and mobile app design. He is available for hire (freelance and full-time). The API returns structured project data. For extended context, read /llms-full.txt.
